scope: Bounded user-requested review; zero new engine queries or fitting. Supersedes only unexecuted immediate NB fitting in NEXT_FEASIBILITY38. Original declarations/results stay unchanged.
question: Can a prospective few-piece distribution supply genuine outcome information about B/N against a searching opponent cheaply?
primary: J24 = mean(actual win +1, actual loss -1, actual draw 0, unresolved at 24 plies 0). Unresolved is a separate censored class, never a draw or quantity-based win. This is finite-horizon event return, not eventual WDL.
diagnostics: W/L/D/C and termination time per opponent/color/family
first candidate action and whole trajectory changes
paired transitions including lost wins and new losses
cost including producer, audit, engineering and review
next_action: Implement and freeze a new price-blind zero-prefix NB root generator before any query. Move kings closer than task875 and retain cooperative two-N/two-B inventory. Pilot training roots only.

proposed_grammar.inventory: two N and two B plus two kings; no R
proposed_grammar.mechanics: retain promotion, hand/drop and relevant history exactly as engine/controller support
proposed_grammar.acceptance: legal nonterminal state, nonmoving king not in check, moving side has at least two legal actions; no screening by prices, wins or human values
proposed_grammar.failures: all original attempted seeds retained; no resampling

freeze_before_execution: Exact placement/RNG, fresh disjoint seeds, family train/dev/validation allocation, color/opponent RNG, fixed budget and audit source must be written before collection; this design is not a claim of an already executed or fully frozen experiment.

pilot.limit: At most 16 attempted training families, 256 closed games and 120 seconds producer wall time; preserve partial/failed results. No new fit in pilot.

pilot_decision: Look for actual terminal-contribution changes in at least two independent families against search, and report coverage/censoring and random-opponent results separately. This is a practical information check, not proof of identifiable values or a user-approval gate. If weak, assess a changed prospective grammar or costed small exact-state feasibility; do not add unchanged epochs or quantity reward.

fit_after_useful_pilot.price_axis: one B/Horse family coefficient relative to fixed N90
fit_after_useful_pilot.objective: strict J24 improvement only; retain current parameter on ties. Fast-mate score reported separately, not used to certify a precise price.
fit_after_useful_pilot.starts: at least four seeded arbitrary grid starts fixed before outcomes; adjacent-grid local ascent with exact frozen-condition cache
fit_after_useful_pilot.interpretation: Report score landscape and plateau/range. A shared exhaustive argmax returned from all starts is convergence by construction, not evidence of initialization independence.

validation: Before fitting, freeze independent families/opponents and a fixed-index small control subset at H12/H24/H48 and nodes256/1024. Preserve all endpoints, losses, unresolved cases and horizon reversals; no result-driven extension or selected favorable roots.
transfer: NR and NB edges then prospective NRB composition. Tied promoted-family coefficients are explicit restrictions, not independently learned promoted-piece prices. Keep evaluation, ordering, SEE and cached native consumers distinguished.
claim_boundary: Conditional useful ratios under declared start/opponent/search distribution. Human-price comparison only after endpoints freeze. Current modified YaneuraOu evidence does not establish stock Stockfish/NNUE or full generic-rule learning feasibility. Tablebases optional after state-space/cost estimate; no mandatory platform rewrite.
